body: A phase or implement step that saves a `cargo build` run's output into its run dir commits the project root's absolute path: cargo's `Compiling {crate} v{version} ({root}/{path})` lines name it. `gate.py hygiene` refuses the file as an in-root host path. Because the path is under the root, `gate.py respell` fixes it, dropping the root prefix and nothing else, and the respell is recorded. Where it applies: any build or test capture kept as evidence. Keep the raw capture in the session scratchpad with its figures in a record, or respell it before the hygiene read. Extended 2026-11-20: a jscpd duplication report written into the chunk's evidence with `--absolute` holds the same in-root paths in its `jscpd-report.json`, and the same `gate.py respell` fixes it before the hygiene read, the report still reading the same figures.

body:
The session moved the stand checks' repeated boot, act and answer-read setup into the test crate's shared modules, a refactor of test code only.
Every stand check stays one target a file with the same tests, names, messages and literal set; no target was added, renamed or removed.
No product source, manifest, lockfile, CI script, committed check or dependency changed; the shared modules stay silent, with no print, subscriber, env read, log site or span added.
Measured: the stand checks' duplication fell from 75 pairs and 870 lines to 42 and 358, and the whole duplication reading from 4.05 to 3.74 percent; no row holds either count.
The MCP answer-read helper, the recorded-check helper and the element-mark reader now live in shared test modules; the upstream-taken test duplication is kept, untouched, its keep-or-fold question still unanswered.
CI on the pre-CI commit read green, 17 of 17 checks, the windows leg included.

the stand check that MCP server results carry masked control values, never a password or file value
the stand check of the snapshot's parts — snapshot text, id and name fields, state words — over MCP results
the stand check of the MCP server's tools — listing, tool results, isError, size bounds, the covered and fonts-unavailable refusals, and the tool_call span
the stand check that the value mask holds on every new answer and carrier
the stand check of session state held between calls, focus included
the stand check of the actions answer's keyed flag and the one actionable rule

the stand check of the actions answer — id, owner, verbs, nodes — and that the actions read changes nothing

the stand check of the diff an acting verb answers, its node keys, agreeing across settle modes

the stand check that a click lands on a transformed element through its visible region
the stand check of acting verbs that load a page, the bounded load wait and the virtual clock
the stand check of recording and replay — the recorded check file, kept verbs, replay through the session run, recording ending on failure

body: Rows whose guard cell names a stand target among the 21 changed checks: each target keeps its name, one target a file, its tests the same; the guard is neither renamed nor moved, only its setup now calls shared helpers. No claim changes.

Masked values: masked-input-values, password-file-value-masked, mask-holds-on-every-carrier, contract mcp-result masked-control-values, contract masked-input-value and snapshot-value MASKED_VALUE — guarded by the masked MCP and masks-on-new-answers stand checks, whose MCP calls and result reads now go through the shared helpers.

MCP results and errors: mcp-result-crossing, mcp-bounded-lines, mcp-listing-fixed-text, mcp-errors-fixed-no-data, contract mcp-tool-result is-error, size-bound and screenshot, contract mcp-errors and mcp-protocol-errors — the shared MCP tool result decoder now reads isError for the stand checks; the MCP tools check keeps its own isError assertion.

Refusal rows: closed-refusal-cause-set, refusal-closed-cause-set, refusal-holds-no-call-input, contract refusal-causes covered, fonts-unavailable, off-screen and the rest, contract refusal-json — guarded by the refusal stand checks, whose served exchanges now come from the shared exchange; messages and reply counts unchanged.

Recorded check and replay: recorded-check-untrusted, recorded-check-strict-reader, recorded-type-masked, replay-through-session-run, recording-ends-on-failure, recording-bounds-end-recording, contract recorded-check items — the unix-only recorded check writer moved into the shared session helpers; the replay check's assertions folded into private helpers, each message kept.

Actions answer rows: actions-answer-crossing, actions-keyed-field, actions-read-changes-nothing, one-actionable-rule, contract actions-answer id, owner, verbs, nodes and keyed — guarded by the actions and actionable-keys stand checks, whose lean task boot and held session moved to the shared helpers.

Snapshot and state readings: snapshot-state-readings, control-states-closed-values-only, toggle-read-per-role, contract snapshot-text items and diff-node keys — guarded by the snapshot-parts, act-states and act-diff stand checks, whose stepping now goes through the shared settled step and mode agreement.

Visible region and hit rows: visible-region-through-transforms, non-invertible-transform-no-hit, programmatic-scroll-clamped, target-refusal-order, unknown-target-refused — guarded by the obstructed, scroll and transformed stand checks, whose edge, centre, area, inside and viewport readers moved to the shared helpers.

Load and clock rows: bounded-load-wait, load-wait-bound, failed-load-ends-wait, settle-never-waits-on-loads, advance-moves-virtual-clock-exactly, time-moves-only-on-advance — guarded by the load-page stand check, whose shared assertion tail folded into one private helper.

Layout and session state: session-layout-read-in-process, no-node-id-between-calls, id-lookup-anew-each-call — guarded by the layout and session-state stand checks, which now declare the shared session module.
test-harness-no-tracing-no-style: the shared test modules gained helpers with no subscriber, print, env read, log site or span; the MCP tools check's recorder stays where it stood.
blitz-tests-not-published: the test crate's manifest and library root unchanged; only its test sources moved.

mcp-tool-call-span and tool-call-span contract rows — guarded by the MCP tools stand check, whose covered and no-font exchanges now call the shared exchange inside the same recorder; reply counts unchanged.
Product source and engine behaviour rows: select list, range, focus, keyboard, CSS, HTML parsing, serialization and stable element id derivation — no product file changed.
Dependency rows other than the test harness one: manifests, lockfile, pins, audit tool, licence gate, advisory ignores, locked builds — no dependency or version moved.
CI and secret rows: CI tokens, actions pinned to SHAs, publish guards, signing material, Actions secrets and environment variables — no CI script or workflow changed and no env read added.
Data protection rows: history in sqlite, HTTP cache, cookies, TLS, clipboard and file dialog, kept-check file contents and ownership — no store, cache or kept check changed.
Outbound network rows and their absences: blitz-net, per-host limits, CORS and same-origin, request timeout, response size limits, CDP server — nothing outbound changed.
The telemetry sink, target allowlists and log scrubbing rows — no log site, sink or target added.
Cold-agent and agent-run scripts, coverage floor checker, apt-install and target sweep rows, and their exit codes — no script changed.
escher-session CLI flags, roles, exit codes and output contracts, and session socket bounds and replies — the wire and the binary did not change; the stand checks read them as before.
WPT runner, CSSOM script API, query API and Dioxus bridge error rows — not reached.
Authentication and authorization rows and absences, and the threat model's opt-in rows for JavaScript and file URLs — not reached.

The stand checks' repeated setup (booting a held task, the in-process MCP exchange and its tool-call lines, decoding the MCP tool result, the settled acting step, the both-layout-modes agreement, element geometry reads, the recording check) moved out of each check into the shared test modules.
Each stand check stays one target with the same tests, names and messages; the fold guard read files 197, tests 930, literals 3636 equal before and after.
Helpers whose body or message differs stayed private in their own check; two more checks now declare the session checks' shared module (44 to 46).
Measured: the stand checks' own duplication fell from 75 pairs and 870 lines to 42 and 358; the whole duplication reading fell from 4.05 to 3.74 percent; the upstream-taken cdp-server and vibey-script tests were left as written, the founder's question on them unanswered.
No product source, manifest, CI script, committed check or seven_guis test changed; fast, stand-repeat (3 of 3 rounds) and a11y legs green, CI 17 of 17 green including the windows leg.

body: The rule that session checks share one module: its shared module now holds the stand checks' boot, MCP exchange, answer-read, settled-step and geometry helpers, and two more checks declare it.
The rule that shared fixtures sit in one module: the shared fixtures module gained the element marks read.
The rule that shared test modules are no target and that blitz-tests runs one target per file (one target per behaviour): kept, no target added, renamed or removed, the same tests in each.
MCP tool result text decoded whole: the decoder moved into the shared module as one helper; the lenient decoder stays beside it, and the MCP tools check keeps its own result assertion on isError.
Stand checks run in both layout modes and layout assertions in both modes: the modes-agree assertion and the held task's settled step moved into the shared module, still called in both modes.

Recording checks and socket session checks unix-gated: the recording check helper moved into the shared module under the same unix gate; its off-unix compile was witnessed by the CI windows leg, not on the host.
MCP role tested as a child and in process: the in-process MCP exchange now goes through one shared helper taking the boot as a parameter; reply counts and messages unchanged.
Test failures print no argument value and no ids, names or typed text in test names or messages: held, the test name lists and the literal set equal before and after.

Session and stand logs silent: the shared helpers add no print, subscriber, env read, log site or span; the MCP tools check's covered and no-font exchanges still run under their own recording subscriber.
Stand checks repeated three rounds with a zero-failure budget, and every requirement witnessed inside stand-repeat: the moved helpers ran green 3 of 3 rounds.
Cross-OS readings of the served tasks: that check kept its own held-task boot, its body differing from the shared one.
Shared stand tables in one module and shared graph drives: the stand tables were not moved; a picker should confirm the shared helpers do not restate them.
Upstream tests kept as written: the upstream-taken cdp-server and vibey-script tests' duplication was left untouched, the founder's question on keeping them still unanswered.

body_fields.fact: Setup repeated across the stand checks lives once in the shared test modules; a helper whose body or failure message differs from the shared one stays private in its own check.

CI integration: no CI script, leg membership, cache, package install or trigger changed.
Quality gates: coverage floors, mutation testing and the complexity ceiling were not read or moved.
WPT runner, its suites, statuses and pinned commit.
Agent-run and cold-agent contracts, events, verdicts and exit codes.
Committed recorded checks and the recording script: no committed check changed.
The seven_guis headless stand's boot functions and timer step, and the seven_guis tests.
Harness construction, input, inspection, screenshot, contrast and settle contracts.
Lint defects and findings, snapshot node fields and handler coverage contracts.
